title: Subject says visa admission; form says EWI

provenance.source: Team-authored synthetic generalization case (gen-v1), 2026-10-30. Not independently held out.

narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On March 12, 2024, at approximately 0910 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered near Monroe, Michigan during roving patrol duties. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] identified himself as a Border Patrol Agent and questioned the subject as to his citizenship. The subject stated that he is a citizen and national of Mexico and that he remained after his authorized stay expired. The subject presented a Mexican consular identification card. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] placed the subject under arrest at approximately 0910 hours.
ENTRY:
The subject stated that he flew into Chicago O'Hare International Airport on May 2, 2018, and was admitted on a B2 visitor visa valid for six months. He stated that he did not depart when his authorized stay ended.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is removable under Section 237(a)(1)(B) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he remained in the United States longer than permitted.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear.
